entry.title: Unlocking Hidden Content: An Introduction to hidden='until-found'
entry.summary: The value 'until-found' for the hidden HTML attribute is supported by Chrome and Firefox at the time of writing. Also, support has been added to Safari TP and is expected to land this year. Before we look at the 'until-found' value specifically, let's quickly recap what the hidden attribute does when it's added to an HTML element. This attribute tells the browser that the element's contents are not currently relevant and should not be presented to the user. Commonly, the browser will then apply the CSS style display: none, totally hiding the element. In contrast, when hidden='until-found' is applied, this tells the browser that the contents are relevant, but should not be visible initially. Typically, the browser will apply the CSS property content-visibility: hidden, which initially hides…

entry.title: The Great Reckoning
entry.summary: The newsroom at CNET fell silent on a Tuesday morning in January 2023. Not from breaking news or deadline pressure, but from the realisation that artificial intelligence had been quietly publishing articles under bylines that didn't exist.
